events.title: Activity: Upcycled Bookmarks
events.event_detail: Activity: Upcycled Bookmarks is a craft program for children and their caregivers, held at the Excelsior branch library on Wednesday, June 3, 2026 from 4:00 to 5:00 PM. This eco-friendly event teaches participants to create bookmarks using everyday materials that would otherwise be thrown away. In partnership with the San Francisco Environment Department, the program combines creativity with sustainability education. All craft materials are provided, and participants can take their finished bookmarks home or donate them. The event is part of the Summer Stride reading program and is sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library. No registration is required; it operates on a drop-in basis.

events.title: $1 Wing Wednesdays at Underdogs Cantina (SoMa)
events.description: No admission charge. Wings are $1 each
events.event_detail: $1 Wing Wednesdays at Underdogs Cantina is a recurring weekly food and drink event held every Wednesday from 4:30pm until close. The venue, Underdogs Cantina, is located at 128 King St. in San Francisco's SoMa neighborhood, across from the ballpark. Attendees can enjoy $1 wings throughout the event, with happy hour prices from 4:30-6pm. The venue features 25+ TVs for sports viewing, arcade games, and a 300+ person capacity. There is no cover charge or admission fee—attendees only pay for the wings and any drinks they purchase. This is a casual sports bar atmosphere perfect for wing lovers looking for an affordable night out.

events.title: Book Club: Silent Book Club at Magnolia
events.event_detail: Silent Book Club at Magnolia Brewing is a social reading event hosted by the San Francisco Public Library on Wednesday, June 3, 2026 from 5:30 to 7:00 PM. The event takes place at Magnolia Brewing, located at 1398 Haight Street (at Masonic) in San Francisco. Attendees bring their own book (BYOBook format welcomes physical books, ebooks, audiobooks, textbooks, and comic books), order food and drinks from the venue, and enjoy about an hour of silent reading together. At the end of the session, participants can share what they're reading and socialize with fellow book lovers, or continue reading quietly. This is a drop-in event with no registration required. The relaxed format allows readers of all types to connect with like-minded individuals in a low-pressure environment.

events.title: Workshop on Emotional Regulation
events.description: Seminar helping children recognize and manage emotions using movement, stories, interactive activities and guided breathing exercises.
events.event_detail: Kids Finding Calm: Workshop on Emotional Regulation at Bayview Branch Library. This kid-friendly workshop takes place on Wednesday, June 3, 2026. Children will explore simple, empowering techniques for emotional regulation in an engaging, interactive setting. The workshop is designed to help kids learn and practice skills for managing their emotions. This is a free community event hosted by the City of Richmond.

events.title: Workshop: Chair Yoga 4 Everyone
events.event_detail: Workshop: Chair Yoga 4 Everyone is a gentle, accessible yoga class held on Wednesday, June 3, 2026 from 5:30 to 6:30 PM at the Glen Park Meeting Room in the Glen Park Branch of the San Francisco Public Library. This chair-based class uses breathwork, mindful movement and stretches that can be done seated or with a chair for support, making it ideal for beginners, seniors and anyone seeking a low-impact introduction to yoga. The practice focuses on supporting flexibility, balance and relaxation. Presented by Yoga 4 The Bay, a Bay Area organization offering accessible yoga and meditation programs. No experience or special equipment is required. Space is limited and reservations are required by calling (415) 355-2858. The library is wheelchair accessible and accommodations can be requested.

events.title: Workshop: Part 2: Healing Practices for Parentified Daughters of Color
events.event_detail: Healing workshop for parentified daughters of color led by Holistic Life Coach Karolyn Wong. This is Part 2 of a 2-part series focused on "From Surviving to Thriving." The workshop explores the effects of growing up as an eldest or parentified daughter, helping participants access and process feelings through group work, somatic practices, and other activities. Topics include honoring anger and sadness and redefining what being supported and empowered looks like on the other side of healing. Part 1 covered "Grieving Our Inner Children." Karolyn Wong is a Queer Chinese woman and holistic life coach who supports Women of Color and LGBTQ+ communities using Eastern practices like meditation, breathwork, and energy healing. The event takes place Wednesday, June 3, 2026, from 5:30-7:30 PM at the James C. Hormel LGBTQIA Center on the 3rd floor of Main Library in San Francisco. Registration required via external link.

events.title: Red Bull Basement World Final 2026
events.description: Red Bull Basement World Final 2026
events.event_detail: Red Bull Basement World Final 2026 is a global startup competition where first-time founders from around the world pitch their ideas on stage in San Francisco. Red Bull Basement is a global incubator that empowers students and first-time founders to turn ideas into products using mentorship and AI-powered tools, with partners Microsoft and AMD. The event takes place on Wednesday, June 3, 2026, starting at 6:00 PM at Pier 48 in San Francisco. Doors open from 6:00-7:30 PM for networking, food trucks, and activities. The main stage opens at 7:30 PM, followed by the show from 8:00-9:30 PM featuring keynotes, speakers from Microsoft and AMD, and the Top 10 teams pitching their ideas to a panel of judges for a chance to win USD 100,000. An afterparty follows at 9:30 PM. The event is free to attend with RSVP.

events.title: Red Bull Basement World Final 2026
events.description: Going fast
events.event_detail: Red Bull Basement World Final 2026 is a tech and startup competition event where first-time founders from around the world pitch their inspiring ideas on a global stage in San Francisco, the heart of tech and AI. The event takes place on Wednesday, June 3, from 6 PM to 10 PM at Pier 48 in San Francisco, CA 94158. Attendees can expect 4 hours of in-person programming including networking with founders and industry guests, food trucks, activities, and main stage presentations. The evening features keynotes from leading voices at Microsoft and AMD, live pitches from the Top 10 teams competing for the title, and a final winner announcement in front of renowned judges. Doors open at 6 PM for the full experience with networking opportunities before the main stage presentations begin at 8 PM.

events.title: Wiener Wednesday Free Hot Dog Night at Rye (SF)
events.description: Free Hot Dogs with every Hornitos Cocktail purchase
events.event_detail: Wiener Wednesday is a weekly free hot dog night at Rye Bar in San Francisco's Tenderloin neighborhood at 688 Geary St. Every Wednesday from 6pm to close, guests receive a free hot dog with every Hornitos cocktail or shot purchase. The bar offers various toppings like onions, tomatoes, mustard, mayo, ketchup, relish, and jalapenos. They also have gluten-free buns available upon request. Pet dogs are welcome. The bar features craft cocktails including margaritas, palomas, and specialty drinks like the 'Dying Word' cocktail made with coconut fat washed Hornitos.

events.title: Meet the Author: Anita Gail Jones
events.description: Meet the Author event featuring Anita Gail Jones.
events.event_detail: Meet the Author event featuring Anita Gail Jones discussing her debut novel 'The Peach Seed'. The event takes place at the Montclair Branch of Oakland Public Library from 6:00 PM to 7:30 PM. Anita Gail Jones is a visual artist, professional storyteller, and writer born and raised in Albany, Georgia who now lives in Northern California. Her novel 'The Peach Seed' is a sweeping multigenerational story set in the American South, weaving together stories from Africa to the Civil Rights Movement and into the present day. The event includes a discussion period followed by a book signing session after the talk ends at 7:30 PM. This event is suitable for adults and teens and is made possible through the Friends of the Montclair Public Library.

events.title: Activity: LEGO Night and Robotics Exploration
events.event_detail: LEGO Night and Robotics Exploration is a hands-on building and learning event for children ages 5 and older. The program is a partnership with CardinalBotics, featuring the Lowell High School robotics team who will teach attendees about LEGO robotics. Participants can build anything their imagination can dream up using LEGOs and explore robotics concepts with guidance from the student team. The event takes place on Wednesday, June 3rd, 2026 from 6:00 PM to 7:30 PM at the Bernal Heights Meeting Room, located at 500 Cortland Avenue in San Francisco. This is a drop-in program with no registration required. The event is part of the Summer Stride program and sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library.

events.title: South Side Beer Ride Free Monthly Brewery Shuttle | SF
events.description: Shuttle is Free. Beer for purchase
events.event_detail: South Side Beer Ride is a free monthly brewery shuttle event occurring every 1st Wednesday from 6:30 pm to 10:30 pm. The free hop-on/hop-off shuttle runs approximately every 30 minutes between eight participating breweries in San Francisco's Potrero Hill area: Triple Voodoo Brewery (2245 3rd St), Speakeasy Ales & Lagers (1195 Evans Avenue), Harmonic Brewing, Barebottle Brewing Company, Ferment Drink Repeat (FDR Brewery), Laughing Monk Brewing, Seven Stills, and Magnolia Brewing. Transportation is provided by Incredible Adventures with three vans running the route. The shuttle itself is free; attendees purchase their own beer at each stop. Participants can start at any participating brewery, visit multiple locations throughout the evening, and use the shuttle to travel between them. This is a safe and convenient way to explore San Francisco's South Side craft beer scene without worrying about driving.

events.title: Intro to Personal Safety & Self-Defense Class | SF
events.description: Free but an RSVP is required
events.event_detail: Intro to Personal Safety & Self-Defense Class hosted by IMPACT Bay Area. A free one-hour class teaching empowerment self-defense techniques. Students learn intuition, situational awareness, body language and verbal skills to deescalate and deter assault and harassment, plus two simple physical techniques. Open to adults of all genders. Happens every 1st Wednesday of the month from 6:30 to 7:30 pm. Held at a secret San Francisco location - address sent after RSVP. Free admission but registration is required. Completing this intro class earns a discount toward a full Basics course.

events.title: Nākaloka, a benefit, immersive sacred experience in San Francisco
events.description: Going fast - Immersive sacred experience
events.event_detail: Nākaloka is an immersive sacred experience benefit concert held at Grace Cathedral in San Francisco on Wednesday, June 3 from 7 PM to 10 PM. The event awakens the senses through candlelight, world flutes, song, and spoken wisdom from many traditions. Attendees can expect mystic storytelling, recitation, and a shared journey of reflection and inner inquiry in an inspiring venue. The experience unfolds with intention and symbolic depth, guiding the community toward universal truths. Doors open at 7 PM, with arrival from 7-7:30 PM, experience starting at 7:30 PM, and a closing circle with light nourishing snacks and herbal tea at 9:30 PM. This nonprofit event benefits Urban Angels SF, which provides tutoring, school supplies, and educational support to children facing homelessness and poverty in San Francisco. Presented on a donation basis, every gesture matters and your presence is the highest offering.

events.title: Nākaloka, a benefit, immersive sacred experience in San Francisco
events.description: Going fast
events.event_detail: Nākaloka is an immersive sacred experience held at Grace Cathedral in San Francisco on Wednesday, June 3rd from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM. This benefit concert awakens the senses through candlelight, world flutes, song, and mystic storytelling, guiding participants on a journey of reflection and inner inquiry. The evening includes arrival from 7:00-7:30 PM, with the experience starting at 7:30 PM. A closing circle at 9:30 PM offers light nourishing snacks and herbal tea. This is a donation-based event where attendees can make a contribution or claim a free gifted ticket. Proceeds benefit Urban Angels SF, a nonprofit providing holistic educational support including tutoring, school supplies, and mentoring to children facing homelessness and poverty in San Francisco. The event is 3 hours in duration and in-person.

events.title: FREE Hook-Up Horror Stories Tindervention Stand-Up Comedy Show (SF)
events.description: Free with RSVP
events.event_detail: Tindervention is a free stand-up comedy show held every Wednesday at The Function venue in San Francisco's Mid Market area. The event features SF's top comedians sharing their most outrageous dating disasters, from Tinder catastrophes to awkward hookups, ghostings, and catfishes. Shows run from 7:30-9:00pm and last 70-90 minutes with 4-5 professional comics (credits include Cobb's, Punch Line, SF Sketchfest, Clusterfest & Outside Lands). Admission is free with RSVP (first 50 RSVPs get in free), with a two-drink minimum to support the bar and staff. Donations are welcome. Door price is $20 at the door (first come, first served). Lineups change weekly. This is described as brutally honest, wildly relatable comedy perfect for anyone who's ever swiped right and regretted it.

events.title: Rancho Roots: The Californio Legacy in Marin Thru June 6th
events.event_detail: Rancho Roots: The Californio Legacy in Marin is a historical exhibit exploring the lasting legacy of Californio ranchos in Marin County. This exhibit at the Boyd Gate House teaches visitors about the Californios—Spanish and Mexican settlers—who established ranchos across Marin in the early 19th century. The exhibit showcases the history and daily life on these ranchos through artifacts, family stories, and interactive displays. It also connects the past to the present, demonstrating how the ranchos' legacy remains visible in Marin's farms and place names today. The event takes place on Wednesday, June 3, 2026, from 11:00am to 3:00pm at Boyd Gate House, 1125 B Street, San Rafael.

events.title: Farmers Market at Town Center (Every Wednesday)
events.event_detail: Farmers Market at Town Center is a weekly outdoor market held every Wednesday from 11:00am to 5:00pm at Town Center in Corte Madera, located at 100 Corte Madera Town Center. The market features organic and specialty farmers, food purveyors, bakers, and more showcasing their fresh produce and goods along a Mediterranean style courtyard. Shoppers can find a variety of locally grown fruits and vegetables, artisan breads, specialty foods, and other local products. The event runs rain or shine, making it a great weekly opportunity to support local farmers and vendors while enjoying the pleasant outdoor setting of the Town Center.

events.title: "Sick Day" Kayak Tours on Tomales Bay with Point Reyes Adventure Co.
events.event_detail: Sick Day Kayak Tours on Tomales Bay with Point Reyes Adventure Co. is a midweek guided 3-hour kayak tour held on Wednesday, June 3, 2026 at 10:00am. The experience includes a coffee and tea bar with local pastries before launch. Tours are designed to help visitors slow down, unplug, and enjoy the quieter side of West Marin without weekend crowds. Different days feature different themes including oyster experiences at The Marshall Store or Hog Island Oyster Co., waterfront dining at Nick's Cove, or mead tasting at Heidrun Meadery. Tours are $135 per person and offer a unique way to experience Tomales Bay while supporting small West Marin businesses along the way.

events.title: Reuben Day at Pig in a Pickle
events.event_detail: Reuben Day at Pig in a Pickle is a weekly food event featuring the restaurant's signature Reuben sandwich. The event takes place every Wednesday at Pig in a Pickle, a deli/cafe in Corte Madera. On June 3, 2026, the special Reuben sandwiches will be available after 2:30pm (subject to availability). The house favorite features 1/3 lb of Damon's House Made Pastrami on grilled Bordenave's Rye bread, melted Swiss cheese, house Russian dressing, and sauerkraut. Reubens are available for lunch in-house only, and additional sandwiches are sold online and in-house after 2:30pm if not sold out. Attendees can enjoy this popular deli sandwich as a meal or purchase extras to take home.

events.title: Oysters Bingo at Buckeye Roadhouse
events.event_detail: Oysters Bingo at Buckeye Roadhouse is a dining and bingo event held on Wednesday, June 3, 2026, from 4:00pm to 8:30pm at Buckeye Roadhouse restaurant located at 15 Shoreline Hwy, Mill Valley, CA 94941. Buckeye Roadhouse is a historic California fine dining restaurant established in 1937, known for its Old World charm and contemporary American cuisine. The event features their famous Oysters Bingo as part of the dining experience, along with house-smoked BBQ baby-back ribs and the popular S'more Pie dessert. Attendees can enjoy cocktails or wine in the cozy rustic bar before entering the California country-style dining room. The event combines gourmet dining with the fun of bingo games.

events.title: Frank Lloyd Wright Civic Center Tour (Every Wednesday and Friday)
events.event_detail: Join this docent-led behind-the-scenes tour of the Marin County Civic Center, one of Frank Lloyd Wright's last major works and his only realized project for a government entity. Tours run every Wednesday at 1:00pm and Friday at 10:30am, lasting approximately 90 minutes and covering about one mile. During the tour, you'll explore the Board of Supervisors Chambers and their private balcony, get eye-level views of the iconic blue roof, see custom furniture designed by Frank Lloyd Wright and built by San Quentin inmates, and learn the complicated history of the building's creation from specially trained docents. The tour starts at the Civic Center Cafeteria (Room 233). Pre-purchased tickets are required. Adult tickets are $12, seniors (65+) and students/youth (5-17) are $7. Guests should be prepared to walk and stand for the full 90 minutes.

events.title: Tutorial: Meet One-on-One with a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™
events.event_detail: Tutorial: Meet One-on-One with a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ is a virtual event hosted by San Francisco Public Library on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Participants get matched with a pro bono CFP® professional to create a personalized financial plan and receive ongoing support through multiple meetings. The advisors cannot sell products or take clients—they simply listen and help. Topics covered include paying off debt, investing, retirement planning, saving for the future, and building emergency savings. Appointments are generally available on weekdays throughout the day with occasional weekend options. Eligibility requires savings under $250,000, with income limits of $100,000 for singles and $150,000 for married couples. Registration takes about five minutes via the Advisers Give Back website. Spanish-speaking CFP volunteers are also available. This free service is sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library.

events.title: Splash Park
events.description: Splash Park, 9am-12:30pm
events.event_detail: Splash Park at El Cerrito Swim Center is a family-friendly outdoor water play area featuring spray features where kids can cool off and have fun getting wet. This non-lifeguarded area has no pool access. On Mondays through Fridays, the splash park is open to children ages 7 and under; on Saturdays and Sundays, all ages are welcome. Summer operating hours (starting May 2) are: Saturdays 9am-12:30pm and 4:30pm-7pm, Sundays 9am-12:30pm, and Mondays through Fridays 9am-7pm. Drop-in fee is $5 per person for ages 2 and older, FREE for children 1 year and under. A 15-punch pass is available for $63 for residents or $79 for non-residents. The Splash Park and 7 & Under Swim are separate programs - participants must choose one and cannot switch between them. This recurring event runs from May 4 through June 4, 2026 at 7007 Moeser Ln, El Cerrito.

events.title: Storytime: For Families
events.event_detail: Storytime: For Families is a library program featuring books, songs, rhymes, and fun activities designed for children of all ages and their families. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026, from 10:00 to 10:30 AM at the Potrero Branch Meeting Room, located at 1616 20th Street in San Francisco. This is a drop-in program with no registration required. Space is limited, and tickets are available on a first-come, first-served basis at the front desk starting at 10:00 AM. The program is wheelchair accessible, and accommodations like ASL are available upon request with at least 3 business days notice. This event is sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library and may be photographed or filmed for archival and promotional purposes.

events.title: Join Biggest Community | Investors Founders | San Francisco | Online
events.description: Community networking event for investors and founders
events.event_detail: Join Biggest Community is a networking event connecting investors and founders, scheduled for Thursday, June 4, 2026, from 10 AM to 11 AM. The event takes place in San Francisco, CA, at California 1 venue. Organized by Tablon Global, this free community event targets investors and founders, particularly those involved in early-stage businesses seeking fundraising opportunities. The event emphasizes direct, in-person connections between investors and founders, noting that physical meetings are more effective than emails, cold calls, or door-knocking approaches. Attendees are expected to register their interest, and only shortlisted delegates will be invited to join. The event also has an online contingency if there aren't enough in-person attendees, potentially connecting participants from different cities and countries. The event duration is 1 hour and focuses exclusively on networking purposes, allowing investors to connect with founders and vice versa for potential investment opportunities.

events.title: Workshop: Microsoft Excel for Beginners
events.event_detail: Workshop: Microsoft Excel for Beginners presented by Community Living Campaign. This hands-on class takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM at the Main Library's Computer Training Center on the 5th floor (100 Larkin Street, San Francisco, CA 94102). This is a beginner-level workshop that introduces basic data entry, navigation, formatting, math functions, sorting, filtering, and creating charts. Skills learned can also be applied to Google Sheets. The class is designed for seniors and people with disabilities but open to all beginners. Space is limited and reservations are required by calling (415) 557-4388 or emailing dana@sfcommunityliving.org. The library provides computers, but participants may want to bring personal items to enhance their learning experience. Contact accessibility@sfpl.org for accommodations.

events.title: Play Cafe
events.description: Play Cafe, 10am
events.event_detail: Play Cafe is a free family program held at the Oakland Public Library's 81st Avenue Branch. The event features stories, songs, and playtime designed for families with children ages 0-5 years old. Snacks are provided for both kids and caregivers. The event occurs every Thursday from 10:00 am to 11:30 am, with sessions running from March 19 through June 4, 2026. Attendees can expect a welcoming environment where young children engage in early literacy activities through reading, singing, and interactive play.

events.title: Storytime: For Toddlers
events.event_detail: Storytime: For Toddlers is a free library program designed for toddlers aged 16 months through 2 years and their caregivers. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026, from 10:00 to 10:30 AM at the Bernal Heights Meeting Room in the Bernal Heights branch library located at 500 Cortland Avenue in San Francisco. The program features books, songs, movement activities, and more, providing a fun and educational experience for young children. Space is limited, and tickets are available on a first-come, first-served basis at the children's room door starting at 10:00 AM. Parents and caregivers can enjoy this interactive storytime with their little ones in a welcoming library environment.

events.title: Join Biggest Community | Investors Founders | San Francisco | Online
events.event_detail: Join Biggest Community is a networking event for investors and founders focused on fundraising and building valuable connections. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4 from 10 AM to 11 AM at California 1 in San Francisco, CA. Attendees can expect to connect directly with angel investors, VCs, and fellow founders in a 1-hour session. The format is in-person networking, though if there aren't enough delegates, the event may shift to online. Registration is required, and only shortlisted delegates will be invited to join. This event is ideal for early-stage entrepreneurs seeking funding or investors looking to discover new opportunities.

events.title: Storytime
events.description: Storytime, 10:15am
events.event_detail: Storytime at the El Cerrito Library is a free weekly event for young children. Children ages 0-5 with a caregiver can enjoy fun songs, finger play, movement activities, and reading of books during this 30-minute session. The event runs every Thursday at 10:15 AM at the El Cerrito Library located at 6510 Stockton Ave, El Cerrito, CA. This recurring storytime has multiple sessions scheduled throughout spring and early summer 2026, continuing weekly for families in the East Bay area. It's an ideal activity for toddlers and preschoolers to develop early literacy skills while getting their wiggles out.

events.title: Storytime: For Toddlers
events.event_detail: Storytime for Toddlers is a library event featuring books, songs, movement activities and more, designed for toddlers 16 months through age 2 and their caregivers. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 10:15 to 10:45 AM at the North Beach Library Community Room located at 850 Columbus Avenue in San Francisco. Playtime follows the structured storytime session. This is a drop-in program with no registration required. The event is wheelchair accessible, and accommodations like ASL are available upon request by calling 415-557-4557. The program is sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library.

events.title: Storytime: For Babies
events.event_detail: Storytime for Babies is a library program featuring songs, rhymes, and books designed for infants and their caregivers. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 10:15 to 10:45 AM at the Mission Bay Program Room (960 4th Street, San Francisco, CA 94158). This is a drop-in program with limited space; tickets are available on a first-come basis at the reference desk starting at 10:00 AM. No registration is required. The program is sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library and is held at the Mission Bay branch library.

events.title: Storytime: For Babies
events.event_detail: Storytime: For Babies is a library program designed for infants and their caregivers featuring songs, rhymes, and books read aloud. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 10:15 to 10:45 AM at the Presidio Meeting Room, located at the Presidio branch of the San Francisco Public Library (3150 Sacramento Street, San Francisco, CA 94115). This is a drop-in program with no registration required, making it accessible for families to attend spontaneously. The 30-minute session provides a structured yet interactive experience where babies can engage with stories and music while caregivers participate alongside them. The program is conducted in English and is wheelchair accessible. Accommodations such as ASL interpretation can be arranged by contacting the library at least 3 business days in advance. Participants may be photographed for archival purposes. The program is sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library.

events.title: Storytime: For Families
events.event_detail: Storytime: For Families is a 30-minute library program featuring books, songs, rhymes and fun activities designed for children of all ages. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 10:15 to 10:45 AM at the Noe Valley Meeting Room in the Noe Valley/Sally Brunn branch of the San Francisco Public Library, located at 451 Jersey Street in San Francisco. Space is limited and tickets are distributed on a first come, first served basis starting at 10:00 AM. This drop-in program is open to all families and is conducted in English. No registration is required. The program is wheelchair accessible, and accommodations such as ASL interpretation can be arranged by contacting the library in advance.

events.title: Storytime: For Families Bilingual in English/粵語課程 (Cantonese)
events.event_detail: Bilingual storytime program for families featuring songs, rhymes, books, and stories in both Cantonese and English. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 10:30 to 11:00 AM in the Children's Storytelling Room on the 2nd floor of the Main Library at 100 Larkin Street in San Francisco. This is a drop-in program with no registration required, suitable for children of all ages and their families. Parents and caregivers can enjoy sharing stories with their children in both languages while participating in traditional songs and rhymes. The program is sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library. Wheelchair accessible.

events.title: Storytime: for Families
events.event_detail: Storytime for Families is a drop-in program at the San Francisco Public Library featuring books, songs, rhymes, and fun activities for children of all ages. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 10:30 to 11:30 AM in the Anza Meeting Room located at 550 37th Avenue, San Francisco, CA 94121. No registration is required to attend. Families can expect an engaging 1-hour session with age-appropriate stories and musical activities. The program is wheelchair accessible, and accommodations such as ASL interpretation can be arranged by contacting the library at least 3 days in advance. This event is sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library.

Takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 10:30 AM to 11:00 AM at the Excelsior Meeting Room in the Excelsior Branch of the San Francisco Public Library (4400 Mission Street, San Francisco, CA 94112). This drop-in program is designed for children of all ages and their families. Playtime follows the structured storytime portion. The event is sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library. No registration is required to attend.

events.title: Storytime: For Families
events.event_detail: Storytime: For Families is a library event for children of all ages featuring books, songs, rhymes, and fun activities. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 10:30 to 11:00 AM at the Potrero Meeting Room in the Potrero branch of the San Francisco Public Library, located at 1616 20th Street, San Francisco, CA 94107. Space is limited, and free tickets are available on a first-come basis at the front desk starting at 10:00 AM. This drop-in program is sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library. Families can expect an engaging 30-minute session with stories, music, and interactive activities suitable for young children. All SFPL locations are wheelchair accessible.

events.title: Storytime: For Preschoolers
events.event_detail: Storytime: For Preschoolers is a free library program for children ages 3-5 years old. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 10:30 to 11:00 AM at the Parkside branch library in San Francisco. The program is held in the Parkside Back Courtyard and features books, songs, fingerplays, and other engaging activities designed for preschool-aged children. This is a drop-in program, meaning no registration is required to attend. The event is wheelchair accessible, and accommodations such as ASL interpretation can be arranged by contacting the library at least 3 business days in advance. The program is sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library. Parents and caregivers can bring their preschoolers to enjoy this interactive storytime experience in a welcoming library environment.

events.title: Free First Thursdays at Berkeley Art Museum
events.description: Free admission to galleries. Film programs are excluded
events.event_detail: Free First Thursdays at Berkeley Art Museum offers free admission to the galleries of the UC Berkeley Art Museum and Pacific Film Archive (BAMPFA) on the first Thursday of every month from 11am to 7pm. Normally $18 admission, this event allows visitors to explore the museum's collection of over 25,000 works of art including contemporary photography, conceptual art, Abstract Expressionist painting, African American quilts, and more. Visitors can enjoy scheduled tours, lectures, readings, and other public programs included with admission. The museum also features the Film Library and Study Center. Located at 2155 Center St in downtown Berkeley, the modern facility is an anchor for the city's arts district. Note that film programs in the PFA Theater are excluded from the free admission.

events.title: Activity: Mini-Makers
events.event_detail: Hands-on maker activity for young children encouraging curiosity, creativity and motor skill development. Features different projects each month including art projects, playdough, and science activities like learning what floats. Takes place on the Merced branch patio in San Francisco. Thursday June 4, 2026 from 11:00 to 11:30 AM. Drop-in program, no registration required. For children ages 3 and younger. Sponsored by Friends of the San Francisco Public Library.

events.title: SFMOMA's Free First Thursdays Free Museum Day for Locals
events.description: Residents of the nine Bay Area counties invited
events.event_detail: SFMOMA's Free First Thursdays is a monthly free museum day for Bay Area residents held on the first Thursday of each month. The museum offers free general admission from 4-8 pm (some listings mention noon-8 pm) for residents of the nine Bay Area counties. Surcharged exhibitions require separate paid tickets. Attendees can explore SFMOMA's collection and special exhibitions, including 45,000 square feet of always-free public spaces with mural commissions by local artists. A complimentary coffee offer at Steps Coffee (Floor 2) was available with purchase. The event takes place at SFMOMA, located at 151 Third Street in San Francisco's SoMa neighborhood. Note: As of February 2026, the Free First Thursday program is temporarily paused and being re-envisioned.

events.title: SF's Free Concerts & Food Trucks: Civic Center Soundtrack (Every Tue/Thu)
events.description: Free concert series
events.event_detail: SF's Free Concerts & Food Trucks: Civic Center Soundtrack is a free outdoor lunchtime concert series at Fulton Plaza outside the San Francisco Public Library (Civic Center neighborhood). The event runs every Tuesday and Thursday from 12 pm to 3 pm, starting April 14 through October 2026. Each day features three local performers playing a variety of musical genres. In 2026, food trucks have been added to the lineup, complementing the free live music. The event is perfect for downtown workers, residents, families, and anyone looking for a free midday hangout with food and entertainment. Bring your own lunch or purchase food from the rotating food trucks while enjoying free outdoor music in the heart of downtown San Francisco. The event is free to attend with no tickets required.

events.title: Baby Brigade
events.description: Baby Brigade, 4pm
events.event_detail: Baby Brigade is a weekly event at The New Parkway Theater in Oakland designed for parents with infants to watch movies with their baby in tow. Held generally at 4pm on Thursdays, the event shows regular movie features in a baby-friendly atmosphere where parents can bring strollers and the audience is understanding of baby noises. The volume is lowered but some movies can still be loud, so ear plugs are recommended for noise-sensitive babies. No need to arrange a babysitter - just bring your infant and enjoy an adult movie in a relaxed setting. The event is part of The New Parkway Theater, located at 474 24th St in Oakland's Uptown neighborhood.

events.title: Halau O Keikiali'i
events.description: Halau O Keikiali'i hula performance, 4pm
events.event_detail: Halau O Keikiali'i is a traditional Hawaiian hula school performing at the Berkeley Public Library Claremont Branch on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM. The event is part of the library's "Plant a Seed, Read" summer reading program. Under the direction of Kumu Hula Kawika Alfiche, the group shares Hawaiian culture through music, dance, chant, and storytelling. Founded in 1994, the halau educates audiences about Hawaiian customs, values, and protocols through entertaining performances. This is a free family-friendly event suitable for all ages, including babies, toddlers, preschoolers, and grade schoolers. Attendees can expect to learn about Hawaiian traditions, watch traditional hula performances, and experience the rich cultural heritage of Hawaii. The event is held indoors in the library's community room.

events.title: Hotel Emblem Pride Art Walk w/ Sisters of Perpetual Indulgence (SF)
events.description: Free admission, food and beverages available for purchase
events.event_detail: Hotel Emblem Pride Art Walk is a Pride Month celebration event held during SF First Thursdays on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM at Hotel Emblem (562 Sutter St, San Francisco, CA). The event features an art installation by Castro muralist Elliott Nathan with works from San Francisco Gallery & The Midway Gallery, live DJ sets by DJ boots throughout the evening, and a special blessing from The Sisters of Perpetual Indulgence at 8 PM. Guests can sip on specialty Pride cocktails at Obscenity Bar & Lounge, with 20% of all bar proceeds donated to The Sisters of Perpetual Indulgence. The event celebrates Pride in bold, expressive fashion with art, cocktails, music, and unapologetic self-expression. Admission is free; food and beverages available for purchase.

events.title: Into the Streets, Civic Joy Fund + Another Planet Entertainment Present Downtown First Thursdays w/ Janelle Monáe (DJ Set)
events.description: Downtown First Thursdays with Janelle Monáe (DJ Set) presented by Into the Streets, Civic Joy Fund + Another Planet Entertainment
events.location: Market & 2nd, Market St. & 2nd St., San Francisco, CA, 94111
events.event_detail: Downtown First Thursdays (DFT) is a free monthly street party in San Francisco's Downtown, held every first Thursday of the month. On June 4, 2026, the event features a special performance by Janelle Monáe (DJ Set) from 7:30-9PM, presented by Another Planet Entertainment. The event runs from 5PM onwards, with three blocks of fun along 2nd Street between Market and Howard Streets. Attendees can expect DJs, live performances, dancing, drag shows, food trucks, shopping, and all-ages entertainment. There is a Howard Stage Happy Hour from 5-7PM with house-party vibes, plus outdoor bar specials including $8 draft beers, $10 margaritas, and $15 wells shots + beer. RSVP gets you $3 off specialty cocktails at all DFT outdoor bars. The event is free and all ages. Public transit is strongly recommended (Montgomery Station, MUNI & BART). ADA seating available by request.

events.title: SkinSpirit Presidio Heights Grand Re-Opening
events.description: Almost full
events.event_detail: SkinSpirit Presidio Heights Grand Re-Opening celebration on Thursday, June 4 from 5 PM to 8 PM. This 3-hour in-person event marks the re-opening of the San Francisco clinic and spa following a recent expansion and remodel. Attendees can meet the expert team, explore the new space, and learn about popular treatments. The event features light bites, drinks, exclusive event-only specials, and surprises. Those who book a new treatment during the event receive 20% off and a luxury goodie bag with medical-grade skincare. Open to both existing clients and newcomers. Space is limited and RSVP is required. Location: 3325 Sacramento Street, San Francisco, CA 94118.

events.title: SF's Free DFT Monthly Block Party: Downtown First Thursdays (2026)
events.description: Free with RSVP
events.event_detail: Downtown First Thursdays is a free monthly block party held on the first Thursday of every month from 5:00 pm to 10:00 pm, rain or shine, at 2nd Street between Market and Howard Streets in San Francisco. The event features DJs, live performances, dancing, drag shows, food trucks, shopping with local vendors, arts and crafts pop-ups, and karaoke. Highlights include dancing under the Biggest Disco Ball West of the Mississippi at Discoteca, Curbside Karaoke, and a genre-fluid Howard Stage happy hour dance party from 5-7pm. Happy hour specials include $8 draft beers, $10 margaritas, and $15 shots plus beer. The event is free and all ages welcome, with ADA seating available. Different special guest performers appear each month, curated by Grace Towers, Another Planet Entertainment, Carnaval SF, and Black Joy Parade.

events.title: SkinSpirit Presidio Heights Grand Re-Opening
events.description: Almost full - Grand re-opening celebration
events.event_detail: SkinSpirit Presidio Heights Grand Re-Opening celebration on Thursday, June 4 from 5 PM to 8 PM. This event marks the reopening of the SkinSpirit clinic & spa following a recent expansion and remodel. Attendees can meet the expert team, explore the newly designed space, and learn about their most-loved treatments. The evening includes light bites, drinks, exclusive event-only specials, and surprises. Guests who book a new treatment at the event receive 20% off and a luxury goodie bag with medical-grade skincare products. The venue is located at 3325 Sacramento Street, San Francisco, CA 94118. Space is limited and RSVP is required. Suitable for both longtime clients and newcomers to SkinSpirit.

events.title: Movies on the Square 2026: Free Double Features Every Thursday (Redwood City)
events.description: FREE! ALL AGES!
events.event_detail: Movies on the Square is a free outdoor cinema event held every Thursday from June 4 through September 3, 2026, at Courthouse Square in Redwood City (2200 Broadway). Now celebrating its 20th year, this beloved community event features double features with a kids movie at 6pm and a main feature at 8:30pm. The 2026 schedule includes films like Captain America: Brave New World, Wicked for Good, Raiders of the Lost Ark, A Minecraft Movie, Superman, and more. The venue features an impressive LED screen with HD projection and surround sound for excellent viewing. Attendees are encouraged to arrive early to claim their space, bring blankets to sit on the ground, and enjoy take-out from nearby restaurants. The event is completely free and open to all ages, creating an energetic, family-friendly atmosphere for unforgettable summer movie nights under the stars.

events.description: Event registration encouraged

events.event_detail: "First Thursdays" Live Music is a free outdoor concert series held on the first Thursday of each month from June through September 2026 at The Village at San Antonio Center in Mountain View. Each...

events.title: Lower Polk / TL Art Walk | Trendyloin
events.description: Art walk
events.event_detail: The SF First Thursday Art Walk is a free monthly event held every first Thursday from 6-10 pm in San Francisco's Tenderloin and Lower Polk District. The event makes 27+ galleries available late night to the public for an art walk experience. This is not a bar crawl - each location is either a traditional gallery or a retail space with room dedicated to fine art. Occasionally there are special events showcasing local independent artists along with food trucks. Galleries involved include 826 Valencia, ARGONAUT, Aspect Framing Store & Gallery, Blur, Book & Job, CounterPulse, Emperor Norton's Boozeland, The Family Room SF, LOOK Gallery, SMAart Gallery & Studio, Tenderloin Museum, and many more. The venue is along Polk St. and Sutter St. in the Lower Polk / Gulch Corridor neighborhood. Attendees can explore diverse art exhibitions, meet local artists, discover new galleries, and enjoy San Francisco's art scene during this free community event.

events.title: Oakland's Free POC Comedy Night (Temescal)
events.description: Free with RSVP
events.event_detail: Oakland's Free POC Comedy Night is a weekly comedy show held at Mesa Maguey, an agave bar and Oaxacan kitchen in Oakland's Temescal neighborhood. The event takes place every Thursday at 7:00 PM and runs approximately 70+ minutes featuring 4-5 comedians with credits from venues like Cobb's, Punch Line, and SF Sketchfest. Admission is free with RSVP via Eventbrite. Attendees can expect an inclusive evening celebrating diverse comedic talent from the Bay Area, with food and drinks (including mezcal cocktails, mole, tacos, and ceviche) available for purchase. The venue is 21+ and attendees should arrive 20-30 minutes early to check in. This event is part of HellaFunny's programming showcasing People of Color comedians in a welcoming bar environment.

events.title: FREE Hecklers Welcome SF's First Stand-Up Comedy Show That Invites Heckling
events.description: Free with RSVP
events.event_detail: Hecklers Welcome is San Francisco's first stand-up comedy show that encourages audience heckling and participation. The show takes place every Thursday from 7:30 PM to 9:00 PM at The Function venue, located at 1414 Market Street in the Mid Market area of San Francisco. The event features 4-5 professional comedians from venues like Cobb's, Punch Line, and SF Sketchfest, performing in a fast-paced 70-90 minute show. Audience members are invited to talk back, roast performers, and challenge the comics. First 50 RSVPs enter free, otherwise $20 at the door. The venue has a two-drink minimum. Lineups change weekly, and donations are welcome.

events.title: Clara La San
events.description: Concert

events.title: Arcade Karaoke: SF's Wild New Thursday Night Party + $3 Shots (SF)
events.description: Free with RSVP. - 21+
events.event_detail: Arcade Karaoke is a wild Thursday night party held at The Function venue, located at 1414 Market Street in San Francisco's Mid Market area. The event runs every Thursday from 9pm until 2am. Attendees can expect live band karaoke with guitars, drums, piano, and over 1000 songs. The evening features Guitar Hero tournaments, arcade games like Super Smash Bros, Grand Theft Auto, and Mario Kart on giant projectors. Hosted by MC Dirty Murty, the event includes immersive lighting effects and an AI Rockstar Robot drummer. Happy Hour deals run all night with Crazy Hour offering $3 shots every hour on the hour. A VIP Rockstar Pass is available for $10 for faster stage access and priority seating. Free admission with RSVP, 21+ only. Two drink minimum applies to support bar staff.

events.title: 16th & Mission Open Mic (w/out a mic)
events.description: Absolutely free for all!
events.event_detail: 16th & Mission Open Mic (w/out a mic) is a free weekly outdoor open mic event held every Thursday from 9pm to midnight at the southwest streetcorner of 16th & Mission BART station in San Francisco. Celebrating nearly 20 years, this inclusive event welcomes poets, musicians, emcees, comedians, and all forms of artistic expression in any language. The venue is outdoors amidst pigeons under the stars. Absolutely free for all attendees, no registration required. Whether you want to perform or watch, come support your local streetcorner community and enjoy the authentic San Francisco open mic experience.

events.title: Every Thursday: Inner Circle Dance Party at White Rabbit (SF)
events.description: Inner Circle is always Free with RSVP
events.event_detail: Inner Circle is a free weekly dance party held every Thursday from 9pm to 1am at White Rabbit (3138 Fillmore St., San Francisco). The event features guest DJs spinning House, Disco, Remixes, Currents, Classics and more. It's a long-running Thursday night tradition celebrating dance music culture with no cover charge. Attendees can expect an energetic atmosphere dedicated to DJ culture and dance music, featuring fresh lineup of guest DJs who bring unique energy to every set. The venue has two rooms and two bars. Free admission with RSVP. The party runs ongoing through January 1st.

events.title: Sadderday: An Emo/Pop-Punk/Screamo Dance Party | SF
events.description: Dance party
events.event_detail: Sadderday is a recurring dance party celebrating the emo, pop-punk, and screamo era. Held every first Thursday of the month at 9:30 pm at Pop's Bar in San Francisco's Mission District, this free event invites attendees to relive the nostalgia of white belts, MySpace profiles, and dramatic bangs. The dance floor stays packed all night spinning emo, pop punk, post-hardcore, screamo, indie, electro, and 90s/2000s hits. Partygoers can expect an energetic atmosphere with like-minded fans ready to dance, sing along, and embrace their early 2000s alter egos. The venue is located at 2800 24th St, San Francisco, CA 94110. No cover charge makes this an affordable night out for anyone looking to unleash their inner emo.

events.title: Free Karaoke Night Every Thursday (Bottom's Up)
events.description: FREE ENTRY ALL NIGHT
events.event_detail: Free Karaoke Night Every Thursday at Bottom's Up bar. This recurring event offers free entry all night and runs every Thursday from 10PM to 2AM. The venue is located at 4704 Mission St., San Francisco, CA 94112 in the Mission District. Attendees can expect a night of singing and fun with karaoke from late night into the early morning hours. The event is 21+ only. No cover charge, making it an accessible and budget-friendly way to enjoy karaoke in San Francisco.

events.title: Thirsty Thursdays at Pixels Arcade Taproom
events.event_detail: Thirsty Thursdays at Pixels Arcade Taproom is a 21+ adult retro arcade bar experience happening on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 6:00pm to 10:00pm in Marin County. The venue features over 30 retro arcade games, pinball machines, and a console gaming lounge in a retro-modern atmosphere with comfy seating, great music and visuals. Guests can enjoy a self-pour beverage bar with local craft beers, cider, wine, and non-alcoholic options. Food available includes wood-fired pizzas, burgers, buffalo wings, fries, nachos, and salads from neighboring restaurants. Special Thursday deal: 15% off drinks all evening. General admission ranges from $10-$15 for one hour to all-day passes depending on the day. Group discounts available for 5 or more guests.

events.title: Farmers Market at Veteran's Memorial Parking Lot (Every Thursday)
events.event_detail: The Thursday Marin Farmers Market is a premier weekly outdoor market held at the Veterans Memorial Parking Lot at Marin Center in San Rafael. Open every Thursday year-round, rain or shine, from 8:00am to 1:00pm, this market is known as the local chef's market where Bay Area chefs come to source the freshest seasonal ingredients. The market features over 100 local farmers, specialty food purveyors, and artisans selling locally grown organic produce, local seafood, grass-fed meats, pastured eggs, milk and cheese, nuts and nut butters, honey, rice and grains, breads and baked goods, plants and fresh-cut flowers, coffee, hot and prepared foods, artisanal crafts, jewelry, soap, and personal care items. It is also one of the most anticipated mid-week lunch destinations in the area, offering a vibrant community atmosphere where visitors can shop for fresh groceries, sample local foods, and enjoy the outdoor market experience.

events.title: Bioluminescence Kayak Tour of Tomales Bay with Blue Waters Kayaking
events.event_detail: A nighttime bioluminescence kayak tour on Tomales Bay hosted by Blue Waters Kayaking. The event takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026 at 8:00pm and runs approximately 3 hours. Participants paddle in tandem kayaks to witness bioluminescent dinoflagellates that emit bluish-white flashes when disturbed. On moonless nights, the water comes alive with glowing organisms, and schools of fish create phosphorescent trails. Watch for seals chasing fish and Night Herons hunting along the water. The tour launches from Miller Boat Launch next to Nick's Cove restaurant. Participants must be at least 13 years old, register in even-numbered groups (2, 4, etc.) since only tandem kayaks are used, and those under 18 need an adult supervision. The first 30-40 minutes are spent on-shore preparing. Tickets are $209.88 per person. Tours operate when the moon is dark, approximately 12 nights each month.

events.title: "Surf, Skate, Street" Art Exhibit at Marin Civic Center Gallery Thru September 24th
events.event_detail: "Surf, Skate, Street" is an art exhibition celebrating the creative cultures of surfing, skateboarding, and street art through dynamic works that explore movement, individuality, and self-expression. The exhibit features local artists alongside artists from the San Quentin Rehabilitation Center, showcasing how surf, skate, and graffiti cultures have shaped a bold visual language inspired by coastlines, city streets, and community identity. Through works that blur the line between sport and art, the exhibition examines themes of freedom, rebellion, creativity, and innovation across generations. On view at the Marin Civic Center Art Gallery (1st Floor) from May 14 through September 24, 2026, during regular business hours: Monday through Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm. Attendees can expect to view paintings, prints, and mixed media pieces that celebrate urban and coastal subcultures. Located at 3501 Civic Center Drive in San Rafael, the gallery offers free admission for visitors to explore Bay Area artistic talent.

events.title: Prime Rib Dinner Every Thursday Night at Range Cafe, Peacock Gap
events.event_detail: Prime Rib Dinner Every Thursday Night at Range Cafe, Peacock Gap is a weekly dining event featuring a slow-roasted Prime Rib served au jus, accompanied by mashed potatoes, seasonal vegetables, and your choice of house salad or soup of the day. The dinner takes place every Thursday at 4:30pm at Range Cafe located within the Peacock Gap Golf Club. Priced at $38 per person plus tax and gratuity, reservations are recommended. This is a casual upscale dining experience perfect for meat lovers looking for a quality prime rib dinner without the typical steakhouse atmosphere. Guests can enjoy a leisurely dinner in a relaxed restaurant setting.

events.title: Food Truck Thursdays at the Village in Corte Madera
events.event_detail: Food Truck Thursdays at The Village in Corte Madera is a recurring outdoor dining event held every Thursday from 11:00am to 3:00pm at The Village at Corte Madera shopping center (1618 Redwood Hwy, Corte Madera, CA 94925). The event features a rotating lineup of local food trucks offering a variety of cuisines from savory bites to sweet treats. Attendees can enjoy fresh flavors in a casual outdoor setting while exploring one of Marin County's favorite open-air shopping destinations. It's perfect for lunch breaks, meeting friends, or trying something new. The event runs weekly on Thursdays throughout the summer months.

events.title: Summer Music Series at Town Center Corte Madera
events.event_detail: The Summer Music Series at Town Center Corte Madera is a free outdoor music event held on the first Thursday of each month from June through August. The 2026 series features performances from 4:00 pm to 6:00 pm on June 4 (The Fell Swoop), July 2 (The Complements), and August 6 (Rhonda Sauce). This family-friendly event offers attendees relaxed summer evenings with live local music, opportunities to support neighborhood businesses, and community gathering. The outdoor venue at Town Center provides a welcoming atmosphere for all ages to enjoy food, shopping, and performances in the open air.

events.title: Food and Farm Tour: Flavors of Point Reyes
events.event_detail: Food and Farm Tour: Flavors of Point Reyes is a guided culinary experience exploring West Marin's rich agricultural heritage. The tour takes place on Thursday, June 4, 2026, from 10:00am to 3:00pm (approximately 5 hours). It begins at West Marin Culture Shop in Point Reyes Station. Guests will visit curated artisan destinations including a renowned creamery, oyster farm, meadery, organic farm, and more, with tastings at each location. A locally sourced, farm-to-table lunch is included. The experience provides insight into the people and practices defining the area's food culture. Price is $225 per person. Advance reservations are required, and tours are kept small for an intimate experience.

events.title: Cheese Lovers Tasting with Farm Talk & Seasonal Chef's Lunch at Point Reyes Farmstead Cheese Company
events.event_detail: Enjoy a private Cheese Lovers Tasting with Farm Talk and Seasonal Chef's Lunch at Point Reyes Farmstead Cheese Company in Marin County. This 90-minute experience on Thursday, June 4, 2026 from 12:30pm-2:00pm features sweeping views of Tomales Bay and surrounding pastures. Hosted by a personal cheese concierge, the guided farm talk covers the dairy's history, sustainability practices, herd details, and daily farm life. Guests enjoy an abundant cheeseboard with award-winning cheeses (Toma, Bay Blue, Original Blue, Gouda, Quinta, and more), house-made maple pepper almonds, fresh and dried fruit, artisan crackers, fresh baked bread, chocolate, and olives. A seasonal chef-curated lunch includes gourmet grilled cheese sandwiches, local charcuterie, housemade salad, and dessert designed to complement the cheeses. Pricing is $170 for up to two guests, with additional guests at $85 per person. Reservations open 30 days prior. Not available on weekends.

events.title: Enjoy San Rafael Pacifics Baseball at Albert Park
events.event_detail: San Rafael Pacifics professional baseball game at Albert Park. The Pacifics play in the Pecos League of Professional Baseball Clubs, an independent professional league. Games are held at historic Albert Park from May through July. On June 4, 2026, gates open at 5:00pm and the game starts at 6:00pm. General admission tickets are $10 and can be purchased online. Concession stands offer typical ballpark food including hamburgers, hot dogs, sausages, popcorn, peanuts, candy, sodas, water, beer and wine. Cash, credit cards, and Apple Pay are accepted. The venue is located at 151 Andersen Drive, San Rafael, CA 94901. Attendees can expect an authentic minor league baseball experience with the crack of the bat, the sound of the glove, and the atmosphere of America's pastime.

events.title: Pop-N-Play
events.description: Pop-N-Play drop-in playtime, 9am-12pm
events.event_detail: Pop-N-Play is an indoor play session held at Ruby's Tumbling in Alameda. The event runs on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9am to 12pm, with select dates throughout spring and early summer 2026. Children can come and play in the tumbling gym, with options for parents to stay with their child ($15 per child) or drop off ($35). Siblings receive a $10 discount. Monthly drop-off packages are available for $370. Payment is cash only. The event is suitable for toddlers through grade schoolers. Kids can enjoy open play time in a gym environment with tumbling equipment and play structures.

events.title: Explore Blake Garden
events.description: Explore Blake Garden - free admission, 9am-4pm
events.event_detail: Explore Blake Garden is a free self-guided visit to a 10.6-acre public garden in Kensington with stunning hill views of the San Francisco Bay and Golden Gate Bridge. The garden features native plants, a reflection pool, flower garden, and a Create-with-Nature Zone for kids. Blake Garden is open Tuesdays through Fridays from 9 AM to 4 PM, closed on Mondays, weekends, and University holidays. Parking is free. The event recurs on select dates in 2026 (April through June). Visitors can explore at their own pace, enjoy the views, and let children play in the nature zone.

events.title: Wee Play: Drop-In Playtime
events.description: Wee Play drop-in playtime, 10am-1pm
events.event_detail: Wee Play is a drop-in playtime program for children 6 months to 3 years old, held at the Alameda Veterans Memorial Building (Room 120) at 2203 Central Avenue in Alameda, CA. Activities include developmental and exploratory play that is minimally structured, allowing children to explore on their own terms. Each day features a special focus such as arts & crafts, STEM/numbers/reading, or creative play/dance/music. Children must be accompanied by a parent or caregiver at all times. The event runs from 10:00 am to 1:00 pm on select dates throughout April-June 2026. Registration is encouraged online prior to first visit to add your child to the roster, though paper forms are available. Free to register, but $6 daily fee per child is collected at the door. Volunteers who assist with setup/cleanup receive free entrance. Closed on holidays including Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, and more.

events.title: Dance, Dance, Dance Party
events.description: Dance, Dance, Dance Party, 10:30am
events.event_detail: Dance, Dance, Dance Party is a family-friendly dance event held at the Berkeley Public Library Central Branch. DJ AvoColey plays music while Children's Librarians lead storytime and teach dances from the 80s and 90s. Week one features an 80s Dance Party at 10:30am, and week two offers a 90s Dance Party at 3:30pm. This free event is part of the Plant a Seed, Read summer reading program. Kids are encouraged to bring their adults for a fun morning of music, movement, and stories. The event runs from 10:30am to 11:00am on Friday, June 5, 2026. All ages welcome.

events.title: Bicycle Safety Fair
events.description: Join us for a Bicycle Safety Fair! Learn about bike safety, proper helmet fitting, and road rules for cyclists. Fun activities for the whole family.
events.event_detail: The Bicycle Safety Fair is a community event hosted by the City of Napa during National Bicycle Safety Month. This family-friendly event teaches local youth and community members essential bicycle safety skills through hands-on activities. Attendees can participate in a Bike Rodeo that teaches the rules of the road in a safe and fun riding course. Participants can bring their own bike or borrow one provided at the event. The fair features safety instruction from certified bicycle safety instructors and local partners including the Napa County Bicycle Coalition and CHP Bicycle Patrol. Activities may include a neighborhood ride following the safety demonstrations. The event is free and open to all ages, promoting safe cycling practices for both bicyclists and drivers.

events.title: Death Cab For Cutie Listening Party
events.description: Death Cab For Cutie Listening Party at Amoeba Music Berkeley
events.location: Amoeba Music Berkeley, 2455 Telegraph Ave., Berkeley, CA, 94704
events.event_detail: A release day listening party for Death Cab For Cutie's 11th studio album 'I Built You A Tower' at Amoeba Music Berkeley. The event takes place on Friday, June 5th at 5:00PM. Attendees can listen to the full album, receive free Death Cab For Cutie stickers, and enter a raffle to win an autographed art print. Those who purchase the album (CD, vinyl, or the Indie Record Store Exclusive Teal Vinyl) will receive a free canvas tote bag while supplies last. The event is free and open to all ages. Raffle tickets are free with no purchase necessary, but you must be present to win. This is a fan event only; Death Cab For Cutie will not be in attendance.

events.title: Downtown SF Partnership presents Drag Me Downtown: SF Pride Pop-Up Drag Show Series
events.description: SF Pride Pop-Up Drag Show Series - Drag Me Downtown presented by Downtown SF Partnership
events.event_detail: Drag Me Downtown is San Francisco's signature pop-up drag show series, returning every Friday in June 2026 (June 5, 12, 19, 26) during Pride season. Doors open at 4:30pm with performances from 5-7pm at various downtown SF venues: 101 California Plaza (June 5), Ferry Building Back Plaza (June 12), The Conservatory at One Sansome (June 19), and The Merchant's Exchange (June 26). Produced by the Downtown SF Partnership with Bobby Friday from Haus of Friday, the series features 13 Bay Area performers including lip-syncs, cocktail specials, and glam. The event is FREE with RSVP and includes exclusive Drag Swag (while supplies last). Attendees can expect fierce performances, food and drink specials from local vendors like Pabu Izakaya, Fort Point Beer Co., and El Porteño Empanadas. The event partners with The Transgender District—the world's first legally recognized transgender district—inviting optional $10 donations to support their community programs. All ages welcome.

events.title: Downtown SF Partnership presents Drag Me Downtown 2026
events.description: Drag Me Downtown 2026 presented by Downtown SF Partnership - Every Friday
events.event_detail: Drag Me Downtown 2026 is San Francisco's signature pop-up drag show series presented by the Downtown SF Partnership, celebrating its fourth year as part of SF Pride. This free event runs every Friday in June 2026 (5th, 12th, 19th, and 26th) with doors opening at 4:30pm and performances from 5-7pm. Each week features a different downtown venue: 101 California Plaza, The Ferry Building Back Plaza, The Conservatory at One Sansome, and The Merchant's Exchange. Expect fierce lip-syncs by Bay Area performers including Bobby Friday, with special guest Jax from Season 15 of RuPaul's Drag Race appearing on June 26. The event is free with RSVP (RSVPs do not guarantee entry; arrive early for best chance), all ages welcome, with food and drink specials at each location. Proceeds support The Transgender District. Swag provided while supplies last.

events.title: Summer Fridays
events.description: Summer Fridays event, 5pm-8pm
events.event_detail: Summer Fridays is a weekly Friday evening series running from May 15 through June 2026 at Epicurious Garden, located at 1511 Shattuck Avenue in North Berkeley. From 5 to 8pm, families can enjoy live music performances on the back garden patio and upper terrace while dining on food from Hopscotch Chicken or Itani Sushi. Each week from 5 to 7pm, Happily Ever Laughter provides children's entertainment with costumed fairytale characters performing roaming table-side activities like face painting, balloon twisting, magic shows, and movement games. The schedule rotates different musicians and characters weekly, giving families a fresh experience each visit. No tickets or reservations are required. This is a free event with food available for purchase. The patio setting offers ample open seating, making it an ideal outdoor dining experience for families with children of all ages.

events.title: Family Movie Night: The Wild Robot
events.description: Family Movie Night featuring The Wild Robot at Santa Clara City Library
events.location: Santa Clara City Library, Central Park Library, 2635 Homestead Rd
events.event_detail: Family Movie Night featuring The Wild Robot, an animated adventure film. This free community event is hosted by the City of Santa Clara Recreation & Community Services Department. Families can enjoy an evening outdoors watching a popular children's movie under the stars. The event is held at a local park or community center, providing a fun and affordable entertainment option for families with children. Attendees should bring blankets or lawn chairs for comfortable seating. Concessions may be available for purchase, or families can bring their own snacks and beverages.

events.title: MUSIC & MARKET
events.description: When summer hits Todos Santos Plaza, Thursdays come alive in the best way possible. From June 4 through September 25, Thursday nights have a standing date. The Farmers' Market kicks things off at 4 p.m., then at 6:30 p.m., the music takes over, turning the plaza into an open-air dance floor under the sky. Free admission.
events.event_detail: Music & Market is a free weekly summer event held at Todos Santos Park in Downtown Concord. Every Thursday from June 4 through September 25, the plaza comes alive with the Farmers' Market starting at 4 p.m., featuring fresh produce, street food, and local vendors. At 6:30 p.m., live music takes over the outdoor space, running until 8 p.m. The event transforms the park into an open-air dance floor where attendees can enjoy performances, browse market stalls, and socialize with the community. It's a family-friendly gathering that captures the essence of summer evenings in Concord, combining good food, live entertainment, and a relaxed atmosphere. Bring your own lawn chair or blanket and enjoy Thursday nights with neighbors and friends under the summer sky.

events.title: Jazz, Blues and Bay Sail on Schooner Freda B
events.event_detail: Jazz, Blues and Bay Sail is a Friday evening sailing event aboard the Schooner Freda B on San Francisco Bay. The event takes place on June 5, 2026 from 6:15pm to 8:30pm. Guests cruise past iconic landmarks including the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, and the San Francisco skyline while enjoying live jazz and blues performances. The sail captures stunning sunset and city lights views. Drinks are available for purchase onboard. The event is held at Sausalito Yacht Harbor Slip 465 in Sausalito, CA. Tickets are $107.48 per person. Ideal for couples, friends, and anyone seeking a relaxed evening combining live music with scenic bay views.

events.title: Enjoy San Rafael Pacifics Baseball at Albert Park
events.event_detail: The San Rafael Pacifics professional baseball team plays at Albert Park in San Rafael on Friday, June 5, 2026, with gates opening at 5:00pm and the game starting at 6:00pm. Attendees can enjoy...

events.title: Downtown San Rafael Summer BID Mixer at the Pacifics Game
events.event_detail: Downtown San Rafael Summer BID Mixer at the Pacifics Game - a community night out at the ballpark on Friday, June 5, 2026. The mixer starts at 5:00pm and the game at 6:00pm, held at Albert Park in San Rafael. This event brings together local businesses, neighbors, and baseball fans for a lively summer evening supporting downtown San Rafael and the San Rafael Pacifics. Attendees can enjoy an exciting Pacifics baseball game while connecting with the downtown community in a relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere. Expect a festive environment with ballpark snacks, cheering fans, and a strong sense of local pride throughout the game. A great opportunity to experience local baseball and support San Rafael's small businesses and community organizations.

events.title: Gather at the Grove Fridays at McEvoy Ranch
events.event_detail: Gather at the Grove is a summer sunset wine tasting series held every Friday from 4-6 pm at McEvoy Ranch. The event takes place on the tasting room patio with views of Morelli Pond, offering guests the opportunity to sip exclusive small-lot wines while watching the sunset over the vineyards. Special pricing is available on select glasses and bottles of wine. The event is perfect for date nights or gatherings with friends, creating a relaxed atmosphere to kick off the weekend. Reservations are required and can be made through the Explore Tock website. Located at 5935 Red Hill Road in Petaluma, McEvoy Ranch provides a tranquil setting for enjoying the golden hour with panoramic views of the property's sun-drenched landscape.

events.title: Concerts on the Green in Novato
events.event_detail: Concerts on the Green is a free outdoor summer concert series held at the Novato Civic Green, 901 Sherman Avenue in Novato. The events take place on select Friday evenings from 6:00pm to 8:00pm throughout June, July, and August 2026. The 2026 season features performances including Git With It (June 5), Sean Carscadden Trio (July 10), The Fell Swoop (July 17), Big Blu Soul Quartet (August 7), and Anthony Arya (August 21), spanning genres like Pop, R&B, Classic Rock, Funk, Americana, Blues, Soul, and more. Attendees are encouraged to bring picnic blankets, lawn chairs, snacks, and drinks for relaxed evenings enjoying live music in the park. Admission is free and all are welcome. Pets are asked to stay home for this event.

events.title: Bioluminescence Kayak Tour of Tomales Bay with Blue Waters Kayaking
events.event_detail: Bioluminescence Kayak Tour of Tomales Bay with Blue Waters Kayaking. A 3-hour guided nighttime kayak tour on Tomales Bay where participants can witness bioluminescent dinoflagellates that emit bluish-white flashes when disturbed. The event takes place on Friday, June 5, 2026 at 8:00pm. Attendees launch from Miller Boat Launch next to Nick's Cove restaurant and spend the first 30-40 minutes on shore preparing. Participants may see glowing fish trails, seals chasing fish creating phosphorescent displays, and Night Herons. Tours run on moonless nights (about 12 nights per month). All evening tours use tandem kayaks, requiring registration in even-numbered groups (2, 4, etc.). Minimum age is 13 years old; those under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Tickets are $209.88 per person. Address: Miller Boat Launch, 23240 CA-1, Marshall, CA 94940, USA.

events.title: Frank Lloyd Wright Civic Center Tour (Every Wednesday and Friday)
events.event_detail: Docent-led behind-the-scenes tour of the Marin County Civic Center, a Frank Lloyd Wright masterpiece and one of his last major works (completed 1957). Tours are offered every Wednesday at 1:00pm and Friday at 10:30am, lasting approximately 90 minutes and covering about one mile of walking. The tour includes access to the Marin County Board of Supervisors Chambers and private balcony, up-close views of the iconic blue roof, custom Wright-designed furniture built by San Quentin inmates, and fascinating historical commentary from specially trained docents. Participants meet at the Civic Center Cafeteria (Room 233). Pre-purchased tickets are required (Adults $12, Seniors/Students/Youth $7). Guests should be prepared to walk and stand for the full duration. The building features Wright's signature horizontal design linking three hills, demonstrating his innovative approach to architecture and landscape integration.

events.title: Sunset Sail on Brigantine Matthew Turner
events.event_detail: Sunset Sail on Brigantine Matthew Turner is a sailing experience aboard the tall ship Matthew Turner, offering breathtaking views of San Francisco Bay, the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, and Angel Island. The event takes place on Friday, June 5, 2026 from 6:00pm to 8:30pm. Attendees should arrive at least 15 minutes early and wait at the gate to the pier in front of the Bay Model Visitor Center, where a crew member will meet them. The ship departs promptly at the start time.

events.title: Library Commission Regular Meeting
events.event_detail: The Library Commission Regular Meeting is a scheduled governing board meeting for Sonoma County Library. The meeting is set for Wednesday, June 3, 2026 at 6:00pm. These commission meetings typically cover library business including policy decisions, budget considerations, and administrative matters. Attendees can expect to review agenda items, potentially make public comments, and observe commission deliberations on various library-related topics. The meeting is part of the ongoing governance of Sonoma County Library system. Meeting materials including the agenda and packet are available in advance for those wishing to prepare for the discussion topics.
